I tried both, and they land in the same place. For everyday use I'd go with Version B — the little box right there on the page where I paste and hit Continue. Since I'm always coming here to drop in a link, having the box already sitting in front of me feels quicker and more natural than clicking a button to open a window first.

The one thing I'd ask: keep the review step B shows — where I get to see and tidy the found title and description before it actually saves. As long as I still get that moment to adjust before it lands, Version B is my pick.
